what: A new field added to an API struct (Subset::generic, after translated) compiles and only fails a VM test round later: the API types must declare fields in CBOR map-key order (shorter key first, then bytewise), a rule the compiler and the check do not say.
fix: Reordered the fields. Root fix not built: derive the key order in the codec (or a lint on the API types) so declaration order cannot be wrong.
